title: Explicit monoidal structure on the fixed scalar adjoint
statement: For commutative rings A and B in Type (u+1), a ring homomorphism phi:A→B and a scheme T in universe u, construct a strong monoidal structure on the chosen left adjoint of exact scalar restriction [def-sp-coefficient-scalar-representatives]. Equip B with the A-algebra structure phi.toAlgebra. The native total left derived functor of ordinary sheaf scalar extension has the proved monoidal structure Functor.leftDerivedFunctorMonoidal. Its canonical adjunction to exact derived restriction and the chosen fixed adjunction have the same right functor. Transport the native monoidal structure along their canonical leftAdjointUniq isomorphism. This specifies an actual construction, independently of any representative-normalization assertion.

source.place: Step 2: finite reduction is derived scalar tensor and its compatibility with invertible twists follows from derived tensor associativity; Stacks Tags 07A4 and 0FPT.

proof.text: Use phi.toAlgebra and the proved preservation of K-flat quasi-isomorphisms, flat objects and colimits by ordinary sheaf scalar extension. Apply the native proved Functor.leftDerivedFunctorMonoidal constructor. Compare its derived adjunction with the actual fixed adjunction via Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq, and apply Functor.Monoidal.coreMonoidalTransport. All data are explicit and all coherence proofs are supplied by these proved library constructions.

proof_origin: J2, 2026-10-26: isolate the explicit native monoidal model and its remaining counit equation from existsUnique_finiteTensorCore. Generic construction, cancellation and uniqueness are proved in Lean.
